reason: A DeepSeek Harness adapter that enables text-only models to process image inputs by obtaining descriptions from a configured vision model and delegating text reasoning to a separate model route.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供视觉适配，将图片交给配置的视觉模型生成文字描述，再由纯文本模型完成推理。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness adapter that converts attached images into descriptions with a configured vision model before passing the text to a text-only reasoning model.

capabilities: Sends attached images to a configured vision-model provider for textual description
Replaces image inputs with generated descriptions before delegating requests to a text-only model
Provides configurable provider routes, model identifiers, prompts, and token limits
